# Scratch caller-clause preparation boundary

The source assertion prepares its whole precondition conjunction with its
short-circuit guards. The current local caller path prepares top-level conjuncts
separately, under preceding checked requirements. This diagnostic changes only
that source-clause boundary: the existing preparation, splitter, sole mandatory
checks, local scope certification, original call contracts and publication remain.
It applies the experimental policy to every ordinary locally checked call,
without a product case-selection rule. The selected implementation name bounds
only the saved observation and false-entry control.

Native controls must reproduce their complete recorded solver streams, resource
counts and outcomes. Compare every actual check expression and full attribute;
record any dependency/description changes rather than silently erasing them.
False-entry controls must be genuinely Invalid. No support deletion, source proof
hint, new axiom, global fuel rewrite, raised ceiling or product adoption follows
from compilation or diagnostic execution alone.
